**Description and Requirements**

Job Description
**Who We Are**
  

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology company that leads with outcomes and teams with leaders, bringing more together. Our purpose is to help people and organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows for all. Every day we bring our heads and our hearts to being a trusted copilot, respectful challenger, and unwavering champion for each of our customers.
  

Our strategic vision is to be the first in our industry to lead with bringing more and delivering outcomes as we work to become the world’s most customer\-obsessed and employee\-empowered services company. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co\-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
  

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.
  

  

**Who You'll Work With**
  

Our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We connect across all technical and advisory capabilities, bringing strategy to life through delivery execution that is rigorous, adaptive and outcome driven.
  

You'll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about helping clients solve their toughest business and technology challenges. Our teams lead high\-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it is a multi\-workstream delivery or PMO transformation, we bring clarity, structure and momentum to every engagement.
  

We work in\-person with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are, whether Agile, Waterfall, hybrid or product\-based. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster and build better tomorrows.
  

As a Delivery Leader focused on AI\-enabled client delivery, you will be a consulting leader who assesses how clients deliver projects and products, designs fit\-for\-purpose PMO and AI\-PDLC operating models, and leads the creation and adoption of practical AI agents and accelerators. You will combine program leadership, product delivery, governance, change enablement, and hands\-on solution shaping to move clients from current\-state assessment through pilot execution, measurable value realization, and responsible scale.

PMO AI Leader \- Client Delivery
  

  

**What You’ll Do**
  

\* Lead the successful delivery of projects, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, change control, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes.
  

\* Independently establish program governance, executive reporting, integrated plans, decision frameworks, delivery health reviews, quality gates, and escalation practices that enable timely decisions and predictable execution.
  

\* Own engagement and account financials, including margin, staffing, forecasting, managed revenue, utilization, and profitability.
  

\* Build strategic client relationships, strengthen Slalom's trusted advisor position, and identify opportunities to expand AI\-enabled Delivery, Product, Data, Change, and Technology capabilities.
  

\* Lead AI\-enabled PMO, Delivery Office, Agile, and product delivery maturity assessments across strategy, governance, processes, tools, team structure, skills, data readiness, automation, adoption, and value measurement.
  

\* Conduct stakeholder interviews, working sessions, artifact reviews, workflow analysis, and capability assessments to identify delivery gaps, bottlenecks, compliance considerations, and opportunities for AI\-enabled improvement. \* Translate assessment findings into prioritized opportunity heatmaps, baseline metrics, business cases, target operating models, implementation roadmaps, and recommendations for pilot and enterprise\-scale adoption.
  

\* Define fit\-for\-purpose delivery frameworks that combine Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, product\-based, and AI\-enabled practices while meeting client governance, regulatory, compliance, and risk requirements.
  

\* Design PMO and AI\-PDLC operating models, including governance forums, roles and responsibilities, decision rights, delivery standards, stage gates, escalation paths, metrics, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
  

\* Design, configure, and help build AI agents and agentic workflows by defining business outcomes, context, instructions, tools, data sources, rules, thresholds, human approval points, exception handling, and evaluation criteria.
  

\* Provide hands\-on coaching to Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Delivery Leads, technical leaders, and cross\-functional teams as they adopt new delivery practices, AI\-enabled workflows, and evolving human\-and\-agent responsibilities.
  

\* Champion Delivery Excellence by creating repeatable frameworks, governance standards, quality practices, metrics, accelerators, and reusable assets across engagements.

jobs.title: Director, Canada Strategy
jobs.description:
At Manulife Canada, the Strategy \& Transformation team sits at the center of the organization, partnering closely with the Canada CEO and Segment leaders to shape and advance the company’s long\-term direction.


We work across business lines and functions to translate Segment strategy into aligned priorities, maintain an integrated view of the strategic portfolio, shape high\-impact initiatives, and improve the processes through which strategic and investment decisions are made.  



  

As Director, Canada Strategy, you will help shape Manulife Canada’s strategy and advance its most critical priorities. You will combine enterprise perspective, structured problem solving, and constructive challenge to help senior leaders make clear choices and mobilize action.


This high\-visibility role spans strategy reviews, strategic initiatives, and business and functional deep dives. The Director will act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and help connect Canada Segment priorities with business unit and functional plans.  



  

This role is ideal for a strategy leader who has shaped enterprise or business\-unit strategy in a complex organization or top\-tier consulting environment and is equally comfortable developing strategy, facilitating executive decisions, and moving priority initiatives toward execution.  



  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  

**Strategy Cascade and Enterprise Visibility**

  

* Translate Canada Segment strategy into clear priorities, expectations, and decision criteria for business units and functions.
* Lead periodic strategy reviews and structured check\-ins to assess progress, test whether priorities remain valid, and identify where leadership intervention is required.
* Maintain an integrated view of the strategic portfolio, including both funded initiatives and material work outside the formal book of work, to identify gaps, overlaps, dependencies, and emerging risks.
* Synthesize business unit and functional strategies to assess how they collectively advance Canada Segment objectives.
Help develop and communicate the narrative of the Canada Segment strategy to Enterprise leadership and the Board.  
* 

  

**Strategic Initiatives and Enterprise Problem Solving**

* Lead high\-priority, cross\-business strategic initiatives from problem definition through recommendation, mobilization, and transition to accountable execution owners.
* Frame and evaluate strategic choices, including where to enter, exit, invest, partner, acquire, simplify, or double down.
* Develop fact\-based recommendations through structured problem solving, market and competitive analysis, financial assessment, scenario analysis, and stakeholder input.
* Develop business cases and implementation roadmaps, establish intended outcomes and success measures, and secure senior leadership alignment.
Support partnership and M\&A assessments, including strategic fit, value creation logic, key risks, and integration considerations, in collaboration with relevant subject\-matter experts.  
* 

  

**Business and Functional Deep Dives**

* Lead periodic vertical and horizontal deep dives across businesses and functions, for example – Distribution, Technology, Operations, and other enterprise capabilities.
* Act as the Canada Segment’s thought and challenge partner to functions, testing strategic ambition, investment priorities, operating choices, and alignment with business needs.
* Identify cross\-business opportunities, shared capabilities, and structural barriers that may not be visible within individual portfolios.
Facilitate alignment across business and functional leaders where priorities, accountabilities, or investment choices are unclear.  
* 

  

**Executive Advisory and Team Leadership**

* Provide independent, forward\-looking advice to senior executives and facilitate decisions on complex or ambiguous strategic topics.
* Develop concise executive and Board\-ready materials that clarify the issue, choices, trade\-offs, recommendation, and required decision.
* Build alignment across business units, functions, and enterprise partners through effective facilitation, influence, and constructive challenge.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing, inclusive team with strong capabilities in strategic judgment, structured problem solving, executive communication, and delivery.
* Coach direct reports and peers, allocate resources to the highest\-value priorities
Strengthen the Strategy \& Transformation team’s methods and capabilities – including via the adoption of AI, better operating rhythms, common approaches, etc.  
* 

  

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Strategic Judgment: Connect enterprise context, market evidence, economics, and execution realities to make clear recommendations.
* Structured Problem Solving: Break ambiguous issues into testable hypotheses, focused analyses, and practical choices.
* Influence and Constructive Challenge: Build credibility with senior leaders while testing assumptions and surfacing trade\-offs.
* Executive Communication: Distill complex issues into concise, decision\-oriented narratives and Board\-ready materials.
* Enterprise Collaboration: Create alignment across business units and functions without relying on formal authority.
* Mobilization and Execution: Translate strategy into clear outcomes, accountabilities, success measures, and an executable path forward.
Talent Development: Coach and develop high\-performing strategy talent and raise the quality of thinking across the team.  
* 

  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* 8–10\+ years of progressively senior experience in corporate strategy, business strategy, management consulting, corporate development, transformation, or a related field.
* Experience in financial services and/or a top\-tier consulting firm strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience shaping enterprise or business\-unit strategy across multiple businesses, functions, or geographies.
* Strong financial acumen, including exp

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Software Solutions
jobs.description:
### **Join the Renewed Seneca, The Next Seneca.**



At Seneca Polytechnic, we offer a flexible working environment that supports innovative thinking and encourages exploring new ideas and approaches. As we adapt to an ever\-changing landscape, we continue to promote opportunities for career growth and development. We focus on health and well\-being in all ways to provide great employee experience.

  



**Are you a technology leader who can simplify complexity?**
------------------------------------------------------------


At Seneca Polytechnic, technology powers every aspect of the student, employee, and academic experience. As Seneca continues to strengthen its leadership in artificial intelligence within the postsecondary sector, we are investing in modern enterprise applications, cloud platforms, data capabilities and AI\-enabled solutions that support teaching, learning and institutional operations. We are looking for a technology leader who can navigate complex enterprise environments, build trusted partnerships and deliver practical, scalable solutions that advance Seneca's strategic priorities.  

  

Reporting to the CIO, the Director, Enterprise Software Solutions leads the teams responsible for enterprise applications, systems integration, business intelligence, application development and production support. You will shape Seneca’s information solutions strategy, modernize its digital environment and help ensure technology investments improve teaching, learning, institutional services and student success.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Set a clear direction for enterprise applications and information solutions, with practical roadmaps, priorities and measures of success.
* Work with academic and administrative leaders to understand the real business problem, clarify essential requirements and design solutions that fit Seneca’s needs, resources and budget.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership across a complex enterprise application portfolio, contributing directly to architecture, solution design and problem\-solving while guiding teams and translating technical decisions for institutional leaders.
* Lead major technology initiatives from planning and vendor selection through implementation and continuous improvement, while overseeing budgets, procurement and delivery outcomes.
* Oversee a complex portfolio of more than 100 enterprise and custom applications, including student, learning, CRM, finance, human resources, analytics, cloud and AI solutions, while working directly with major technology providers and maximizing internal capability.
* Improve services through process redesign, automation, analytics and cloud technologies, using existing platforms effectively before adding new technology.
* Balance innovation with security, privacy, accessibility, reliability, cost, risk and long\-term support needs.
* Build strategic relationships with technology partners and vendors, ensuring solutions deliver value, reliability and sustainable long\-term support.
* Develop a high\-performing team by mentoring technical professionals, building internal capability and fostering a culture of learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.

**What You Bring to Seneca**
----------------------------

* Progressive leadership experience in information solutions, enterprise applications or solution architecture within a complex organization.
* Strong technical depth and a willingness to remain actively involved in architecture, design and delivery within a lean, multidisciplinary environment.
* A track record of turning complex business and technology challenges into practical, maintainable solutions that deliver measurable value.
* Experience designing integrated enterprise solutions and leading modernization initiatives from planning through implementation and support.
* Knowledge of application architecture, systems integration, data and analytics, cloud services and modern delivery practices, with hands\-on experience applying or deploying enterprise AI capabilities using solutions from major cloud and AI technology providers.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing budgets, procurement, contracts and strategic vendor relationships.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to explain technical choices clearly and work effectively with executives, business leaders and technical teams.
* Experience with Salesforce, PeopleSoft, Blackboard, Microsoft Azure, Oracle databases and business intelligence tools is an asset. Comparable enterprise technology experience will be considered.
* TOGAF, PMP, Microsoft or Oracle certifications are welcome but not required.
* A graduate degree in information technology, computer science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training and relevant experience.


Seneca supports flexible and inclusive work practices, recognizing diverse leadership styles and experiences. We recognize that leadership experience may be gained through a variety of career paths, including community\-based work, sector transitions, or lived experience alongside formal roles. A combination of education and experience will be considered.

  

**Job Details**



**External Posting Date:** October 13, 2026  

**External Closing Date:** November 03, 2026  

**Job Type:** Permanent, Full\-Time  

**Hours:** 37\.5 hours/week  

**Work Type:** Hybrid  

**Shift:** Monday to Friday  

**Ideal Start Date:** As soon as possible

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
**Position purpose**

The Director of Finance is accountable for the integrity of KHI’s financial management and provides strategic financial advice to the Executive Director and Board of Directors. The position leads financial planning, accounting, reporting, controls and funding administration to support organizational sustainability and responsible stewardship of housing assets and public resources.

The role combines senior financial leadership with hands\-on oversight appropriate to KHI’s size. The Director works with operations staff to understand service needs and translate them into affordable plans, and maintains productive relationships with the City, Region, auditors, lenders and other funding partners.

**1\. Financial strategy, budgets and forecasting**

· Lead the annual operating and capital budget process, establish assumptions and timelines, and consolidate departmental submissions.

· Prepare multi\-year financial plans, property\-level analysis, cash flow forecasts and scenario modelling; identify affordability pressures and options.

· Monitor actual results against budgets and forecasts, explain variances and recommend corrective action.

· Advise on reserves, debt, mortgage maturity and end\-of\-operating\-agreement implications, and long\-term funding needs.

· Provide financial analysis for service changes, major purchases, agreements and organizational initiatives.

**2\. Accounting and financial operations**

· Oversee the general ledger, financial coding, accruals, account reconciliations and timely monthly, quarterly and annual close.

· Ensure accurate processing and reconciliation of accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking, tenant revenue and other financial transactions.

· Work with housing operations to reconcile rent charges, subsidies, arrears, adjustments and write\-offs; support consistent financial controls over tenant accounts.

· Maintain appropriate capital asset records and accounting treatment for capital expenditures, grants, restricted funds and reserves.

· Monitor cash requirements, banking arrangements and authorized investment activity in accordance with approved policies.

· Oversee applicable tax filings, rebates and statutory remittances, obtaining specialist advice when required.

**3\. Housing funding and compliance**

· Maintain a complete register of funding agreements, restrictions, reporting obligations, deadlines and accountable staff.

· Lead financial submissions to the Region and other funders, including budgets, subsidy reconciliations, grant claims and year\-end reports.

· Oversee financial administration of applicable capital and housing programs, including COCHI, OPHI and CMHC\-funded initiatives where relevant.

· Track eligible expenditures, funding receipts, contributions and commitments; maintain supporting documentation for claims and funder reviews.

· Identify and promptly escalate potential ineligible costs, funding shortfalls, missed milestones or repayment exposure.

· Work with operations and project leads to coordinate financial information with non\-financial program reporting.

**4\. Capital planning, asset renewal and development**

· Partner with operations to translate asset condition information and renewal priorities into long\-term capital funding plans.

· Develop business cases and financial models for retrofits, redevelopment, new housing and major capital investments.

· Monitor approved project budgets, contracts, commitments, actual costs and forecast costs to completion.

· Evaluate funding and financing options, affordability impacts and financial risks; support applications and negotiations with authorized decision\-makers.

· Report emerging project variances and recommend funding or scope adjustments through the appropriate approval process.

**5\. Governance, audit and risk**

· Prepare timely financial statements, dashboards and decision reports for the Executive Director, Board and relevant committees.

· Attend meetings as required and explain financial performance, forecasts, funding issues and proposed decisions in accessible language.

· Lead the external audit, prepare working papers and supporting schedules, and coordinate responses and follow\-up on audit findings.

· Develop and maintain financial policies, delegated authorities, purchasing and payment controls, and appropriate segregation of duties.

· Monitor financial risks, fraud exposure and control weaknesses; escalate material issues and implement approved remedies.

· Maintain secure financial records, documented procedures, backup coverage and effective handover arrangements.

**6\. Team leadership and organizational support**

· Set priorities and performance expectations for finance staff; provide coaching, feedback, development and workload planning.

· Build staff capacity through documented procedures, cross\-training and practical guidance on financial responsibilities.

· Support procurement and contract administration with financial review, budget confirmation and compliance with approved authorities.

· Maintain accessible financial records of contracts, insurance, funding and other commitments in coordination with responsible colleagues.

· Provide verified financial records and analysis to support legal, insurance and dispute matters when requested, working with the Executive Director and counsel.

· Improve reporting and workflows while maintaining reliable service and appropriate controls.

· Undertake other related responsibilities consistent with the purpose and level of the position.

**Qualifications and competencies**

· CPA designation in good standing; degree in accounting, finance, business or a related discipline.

· Substantial progressive financial management experience, including staff leadership and accountability for budgeting, financial reporting, audit and controls.

· Demonstrated ability to manage complex funding agreements and capital finances, with sound knowledge of applicable acco
